A crypto futures lab that paper-trades before risking a rupee.

Crypto AI analyses BTC, ETH and SOL perpetuals on Binance, generates signals from 12 strategies and paper-trades them with 1,00,000 of virtual capital, so every strategy is tested on the live market before real money is involved.

See how it works Source on GitHub Built by Shivam Gupta

Paper trading only. Live trading is a deliberately gated final phase. The app needs a sign-in; this page is the public overview.

  • 12strategies, long and short
  • 3 × 5symbols across timeframes from 5m to 1d
  • 5%daily-loss kill switch on the paper account
  • ~130automated tests

Why it exists

Leveraged crypto futures punish untested ideas quickly. Crypto AI exists to test first: it runs strategies against the live market with virtual capital for about a month before any real money is risked.

Everything uses free data sources (Binance public data, CoinGecko, Fear & Greed, RSS news), so the whole experiment costs nothing to run.

How it works

What happens between the first click and the result.

  1. 1

    Backtest

    Run a strategy with slippage and funding costs, compare Sharpe, Sortino and Calmar with buy-and-hold, then promote it to live.

  2. 2

    Scan

    Every 60 seconds the scanner runs promoted strategies and emits entry, stop, target, reward-to-risk and confidence.

  3. 3

    Filter

    An optional meta-label model only lets through signals with a predicted win probability of at least 55%.

  4. 4

    Paper trade

    A paper broker opens positions under risk limits and manages trailing stops and the kill switch.

  5. 5

    Learn, with approval

    The agent proposes bounded changes from regime and performance analysis; I approve, reject or revert each one.

What it does

The parts that make Crypto AI different.

  • One strategy code path

    The same functions drive backtests and live signals, so a backtested edge behaves the same live.

  • Backtests that try to break

    Slippage and funding, parameter sweeps, out-of-sample and walk-forward tests, and Monte Carlo.

  • A paper broker with real rules

    Up to 30× leverage, 1% risk per trade, 5 open positions at most, and a daily-loss kill switch.

  • Market intelligence

    Funding rate, open interest, long/short ratio, BTC dominance and a correlation matrix on the dashboard.

  6. Scanner

  8. Dashboard + alerts

Design decisions

  • Hand-rolled indicators

    pandas-ta breaks on NumPy 2, so indicators are written by hand and tested.

  • The broker is an interface

    A future live broker plugs in without touching the portfolio's risk logic.

  • Propose, then approve

    The adaptive layer changes nothing on its own, and flags results that look too good (win rate above 80%, profit factor above 4) as likely overfitting.

  • Rules before models for regimes

    Regimes come from ADX, EMA slope and ATR rules: transparent, and they need no training data.

Honest limits

Where it stands today, without the polish.

  • Paper trading only. The live broker phase is not built.
  • Live results are expected to trail backtests, and the meta-label model needs about 100 trades before it can train.
  • The AI commentary needs free-tier API keys and switches off without them.

Questions

Can I use it?

The hosted app is private, but the source is public on GitHub and runs locally with one command.

Does it trade real money?

No. It is paper only, and the agent never trades on its own.

What does the AI do?

It writes market commentary, explains backtests and answers portfolio questions. It never sizes or places a trade.
